ConfigGet.description: The options page asks for the profile, every capability's provider and what it could switch to.
ConfigGet.title: ConfigGet

ConfigSet.description:
Switch the profile and/or one capability's provider (for the profile then active) without a restart.
`reset` drops the options page's choice for `capability` (back to clicky.toml or the preset).
ConfigSet.title: ConfigSet

ConfigState.description: Answer to config.get / config.set (with its request_id), and broadcast to every session after a change.
ConfigState.title: ConfigState

ConsentRequest.description:
The brain proposed a browser task: ask the user. The extension works out the sites itself (cookie scope =
the registrable domain of the turn's real tab; a start URL on another site makes the task cross-site).
ConsentRequest.title: ConsentRequest

ConsentResponse.description:
The user's answer in the consent window. `sites` are the registrable domains the task may use, as the
extension worked them out from the real tab URL and the start URL (the model never decides them).
ConsentResponse.title: ConsentResponse

ConversationReset.description: Forget the conversation so far; the server answers with conversation.started.
ConversationReset.title: ConversationReset

OpenScene.description: The scene the companion is showing in front of the page, so a follow-up can change it.
OpenScene.title: OpenScene

PageBudget.description: How much page context the active brain gets. Sent in `welcome`; the extension cuts every snapshot to it.
PageBudget.title: PageBudget

ProviderChoiceWire.description: One provider for one capability, as the options page sets it.
ProviderChoiceWire.title: ProviderChoiceWire

ProviderOption.description:
A provider the options page can pick for a capability. `available` = its package is installed and its API
key is set (health is only known once it is chosen); `models` = local Ollama models, when relevant.
ProviderOption.title: ProviderOption

SceneBuilding.description: The brain asked for a scene and the codegen model is writing it: show the stage with a placeholder.
SceneBuilding.title: SceneBuilding

SceneFailed.description: No scene this time: the codegen model failed, or the repaired code still didn't render.
SceneFailed.title: SceneFailed

SceneRender.description: Code for the scene sandbox; attempt 2 is the automatic repair after a failed scene.result.
SceneRender.title: SceneRender

SceneResult.description: The sandbox ran a scene.render: it drew something (ok), or why not. A failure gets one repair attempt.
SceneResult.title: SceneResult

SessionBundle.description:
The user's login for the task's site, collected by the extension after consent: cookies of the tab's
registrable domain only, plus the tab origin's localStorage.
SessionBundle.title: SessionBundle

SpeechSegment.description: Announces one spoken segment; its audio follows as speech.audio chunks, then speech.segment.end.
SpeechSegment.title: SpeechSegment

description: Bundle model: one property per message family so every model lands in $defs.
title: ClickyTabsProtocol
